mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a supply-demand imbalance that triggers inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative policy response to inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand for housing, which stimulates economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1600), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.
